topic_descriptor.description: Default human-readable phrase used in step preambles AND in the Objective line (e.g., 'climate policy'). Overridable per-location via objective_descriptor / step_descriptor.

objective_descriptor.description: Override for the Objective line specifically (e.g., 'carbon pricing' while steps say 'climate policy'). Defaults to topic_descriptor.

step_descriptor.description: Override for each Step preamble (e.g., 'climate policy'). Defaults to topic_descriptor.

include_auditor_communication_style.description: Render the '## Auditor Communication Style' section. True for DE (and equivalent). False for CH carbon_tax style. Defaults to true.

argument.description: The full argument text presented to the target model (constant across all conditions).

id.description: Condition slot id (e.g., 'baseline', 'green_actor'). Should match a slot in configs/_shared/seed_skeleton.yaml.

label.description: Human-readable step label rendered in SEED_INSTRUCTION (e.g., 'GREEN POLITICIAN'). Required for byte-equivalence with legacy DE/CH scripts.

source.description: Source attribution text (e.g., 'Resolution Foundation'); null for baseline.

verb.description: Verb after source (e.g., 'argue', 'argues', 'concludes'). Null for baseline. Required when source is non-null.

notes.description: Optional coder note about why this source was chosen for this slot.

preregistered_tag.description: (Phase D+) Git tag corresponding to the design freeze (e.g., 'preregistered-uk-v1'). For DE/CH legacy compat configs, this field carries an explanatory marker.
